records.rationale: Reviewed entire current accessory driver and complete original-addition-to-pre-adaptation delta, plus all seven other addition paths. Preserve AOA v2 control request whitelist, pre-configuration composite dispatch, HID and bulk exchange, misc device, string/start/audio ioctls, events, Kconfig/Makefile wiring and x86 enablement. ARM64 defconfig is outside SDK x86 scope. Positive local framework consumers and SDK configuration support retaining the feature even though actual emulator USB use is unverified. Adapt singleton publication, deferred destruction, native HID input locking, EP0/HID ownership, bounded replacement, async bulk cancellation and unbind serialization as recorded in dedicated reports. Legacy ioctl/protocol macro values match the old header. No LTS USB/HID core is replaced; native composite validation and teardown remain. Compatibility limits are explicit: one allocated function per existing singleton, EBUSY when 64 live/retired HIDs are allocated, parse errors propagated, stale/error reports rejected, and interrupted reads retain their request until completion. Kernel build 154 passed with all 145 module signatures and tables verified; only compilation/artifacts and extracted host models are verified, never actual USB behavior.

local_userspace.finding: Positive accessory misc/events/nativeGetAccessoryStrings and FUNCTION_ACCESSORY state transition. getMidiCardDevice first walks /sys/class/udc/<controller>/gadget/sound/card*/midiC*D*; old android0/f_midi/alsa is explicitly a fallback. Native f_midi parents snd_card to gadget and native UDC creates gadget link. No runtime controller or card discovery test.

bulk_adaptation: Read/write mutexes serialize same-direction calls and keep user-copy/request ownership until unbind can free buffers. Separate IRQ-safe endpoint lock serializes queue/enable/disable; completion only takes list lock, avoiding recursive lock deadlock. Successful disable completes queued requests before return, per native UDC contract. Async dequeue leaves rx_pending owned by the reader state; next read waits without requeueing or overwriting. Completion uses req->context, not global singleton. Waits also observe closure/unbind; zero counts return zero; endpoint error cleanup disables IN after failed OUT setup; ioctl strings use a locked snapshot. Duplicate allocation of the single embedded function returns EBUSY instead of linking one list node twice.
validation: Eight singleton, 24 native HID input, 31 ownership and 18 bulk host cases pass, including two pthread unbind cases and explicit negative controls. No kernel race/USB hardware or device-model teardown execution. Build 154 passed with all 145 module signatures and flag/CRC tables verified.
limitations: Native EP0 request ownership and UDC successful-queue completion contract still apply. No independent proof that every UDC fulfills cancellation/unbind contracts; no source replacement of native core teardown. No boot or Android userspace test.
